# Vendored browser dependency

`scrypt-3.0.1.js` is the unmodified `scrypt.js` from the published `scrypt-js@3.0.1`
package: <https://unpkg.com/scrypt-js@3.0.1/scrypt.js>.

Upstream: <https://github.com/ricmoo/scrypt-js>. MIT license reproduced in
`scrypt-LICENSE.txt`. Downloaded 2026-11-05.

SHA-256: `544292934136527d60acc9e337d8c7b953f412e81314aa551a12d4230afd449d`.

Served locally: no CDN is contacted at runtime. Updates require provenance/hash,
license, RFC 7914 known-answer, cross-implementation, and browser test review.
